DreamMoon-MemProcessor 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces an AI memory system with organic persona generation as a core feature.
- Enables AI agents to grow, self-evolve, and maintain persona stability based on experience and reflection.
- Implements a 10-dimensional persona model and a four-layer memory architecture.
- Offers automatic memory persistence and semantic search.
- Provides quick installation and API-based persona generation.
